Theorem
[Wilking's high symmetry-rank classification]

Source: petersen:page-0343 ↗ def:pet-ch8-symmetry-rank 1. ch8:8.3.11Let $M$ be a compact, simply connected, positively curved $n$-manifold with symmetry rank $k$, and $n\ge 10$. If $k\ge n/4+1$, then $M$ has the topology of a sphere, complex projective space, or quaternionic projective space. Moreover, when $M$ is not simply connected, its fundamental group is cyclic.
